Title: Private preview: Azure Kubernetes Service in Azure China

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now available in private preview in the China East 2 region, the first Azure China region for the service.

AKS offers a fully managed Kubernetes environment on Azure, enabling customers to spend less time managing infrastructure and more time building applications.

For more information and to sign up for the preview, see the announcement on the Azure blog.
